name: Terminal
description: Web terminal emulator that renders rows as real DOM text — native selection, copy/paste, browser find and screen readers work. Zig VT parser compiled to a ~49 KB embedded WASM core; wire onData to a PTY/WebSocket backend and term.write() its output. Swap in @wterm/ghostty for fuller VT support; ships its own CSS (`import "@wterm/react/css"`), not Tailwind.
